s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with systemic and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
key_facts: Previous treatments included systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and IVIG
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles on nailfold examination
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with systemic and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
key_facts: Previous treatments included systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and IVIG
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles on nailfold examination

shortlist.label: Lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic photosensitive eruption, violaceous erythema, and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Photosensitive eruption, violaceous erythema, poikiloderma, and radiographic evidence of myositis

shortlist.label: Vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Erythematous, flat-topped papules and nailfold changes

shortlist.label: Sjögren's syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Photosensitive eruption and potential systemic manifestations

raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous erythema, poikiloderma, erythematous flat-topped papules, dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles, along with radiographic evidence of myositis and elevated serum IFN-β levels, are characteristic features of dermatomyositis. The presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While lupus can present with similar skin findings, the specific combination of features and presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies are more suggestive of dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: Juvenile idiopathic arthritis
rejected.why: The primary symptoms and laboratory findings do not align with the typical presentation of juvenile idiopathic arthritis, which usually involves joint inflammation and other systemic features.

rejected.label: Vasculitis
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and laboratory findings do not support a primary diagnosis of vasculitis, which typically involves inflammation of blood vessels and can present with a wide range of symptoms.

rejected.label: Sjögren's syndrome
rejected.why: The symptoms and laboratory findings do not align with Sjögren's syndrome, which primarily affects the exocrine glands and is characterized by dry eyes and dry mouth.
